events.title: Dear Nobody demo: recorded gameplay
events.summary: A recorded run through the free Dear Nobody demo plays here on some evenings (18:00–24:00 CET/CEST) during Steam Next Fest: letters read and answered. It is not live, so a question in chat may wait a while. The demo is free on this page.

events.title: Every word you strike is struck from the love itself
events.summary: What this is You are a censor in a nameless war. Two people who have never met write to each other, and every letter passes across your desk before it reaches the other one. Your job is straightforward and it is written down: strike out what a soldier must not know. But these two have nothing except the letters. A line you black out is not edited — it is gone from the relationship, and you are the only person alive who read it. Then the letters begin, impossibly, to answer your pen. How it plays
